lines: I was dreaming
It was past three o'clock
There was a nostalgic smell of mold
I wanted to tell you that you appeared in my dream
I felt like, after all this time, we could meet with a smile
Like kicking an empty bottle with sandals
About that summer when we were relatively invincible
Every time I look back, I end up burning with yearning
I end up longing for my past self
"It is already time to go home"
That a thing like a way home did indeed exist
You, who called my parasol "exaggerated"
Have you already become an adult, I wonder
Did you manage to become one
Hey, why is it that the end of summer
Feels so lonely
Too early to repeat, too late to look back
Even though I made up invisible enemies
It never made life any easier to live
Stairs I can no longer skip steps on
Even so, shoes that wear down
That I hated the morning because it felt like I was being mocked
That I hated the night because it felt like I was being protected
That on top of such things, a weak, weak self existed
At least, I want you to know
Because I do not want to be disliked
I have gotten quite good at matching the conversation
You, nodding with downcast eyes
Somehow remain without fading away
Hey, why is it that the end of summer
Feels so nostalgic
Every time I touch the memory, it grows faintly distant
Becoming unable to drink cider
No longer liking to get sunburned
I felt like I was denying my entire self from back then
Before I knew it, only those around me are becoming adults
To me, they are simply dazzling
I want to be correct
Even as my height grows, there is something that remains out of reach
And that brought me immense relief
I was dreaming
It was past three o'clock
There was a nostalgic smell of mold
We were two people joking around, mimicking each other's way of speaking
How foolish
Even though there is no replacement
Even though I have known that for a long time
Hey, why is it that the end of summer
Feels so lonely
Too early to repeat, too late to look back
Even if the invisible enemies are gone
Even if life never becomes any easier to live
So that I can at least squeeze back the hand reached out to me
Because the morning sun was always dazzling, just like you
Because the night air is comfortable, just like you
What I do not want to forget is you
And so, the things I hated
What I remember is the summer
